Markets.title: Global Market: China tightens scrutiny of humanoid robot IPOs amid valuation concerns
Markets.summary: Chinese regulators are slowing initial public offerings for humanoid-robot companies due to concerns over soaring valuations and heavy reliance on government-linked revenue. Officials are now requiring these firms to prove sustainable commercial demand and provide stronger evidence of real-world deployment before going public.

Markets.title: FIIs raise stakes in 14 stocks in Q1; shares rally up to 75% in less than 3 months
Markets.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors increased their ownership in 14 BSE 500 stocks during the June 2026 quarter. Following this, the shares of these companies rallied between 20% and 75% in less than three months.

Markets.title: NMDC shares rally 2% after company sets target to achieve net-zero operational emissions by 2047
Markets.summary: NMDC shares rose up to 2% to Rs 80.85 after the company announced a target to achieve net-zero operational emissions by 2047. The plan focuses on renewable energy, energy efficiency, and fleet electrification to reduce operational emissions by 90%.

Markets.title: HAL shares rise 2% as firm hands over 3 aerospace platforms to IAF. What is Goldman Sachs saying?
Markets.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics shares rose 2 percent after the company delivered three indigenously developed aircraft platforms to the Indian Air Force and Pawan Hans. The deliveries consisted of the Dhruv-NG helicopter, LCA Tejas Trainer jets, and HTT-40 basic trainer aircraft.

Markets.title: OFSS shares tumble 7%; Wipro, Coforge, Infosys shares down up to 2%. Why are IT stocks under pressure today?
Markets.summary: Indian IT stocks, led by a 7% drop in OFSS and up to 2% declines in Wipro, Coforge, and Infosys, fell on Monday. The market pressure follows reports of Oracle's $18 billion data centre debt and President Donald Trump's one-year extension of the $100,000 H-1B visa fee.

Markets.title: Global Markets: 5 key things to watch out for this week
Markets.summary: Global markets face a busy week as investors monitor US-China talks, Treasury yields, and Indonesia’s interest rate decision. Sentiment will also be driven by the UN General Assembly, artificial intelligence risks, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.

Geo-Political.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
Geo-Political.summary: German Chancellor Merz described recent state election results as a disaster after his centre-right CDU party suffered heavy losses in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern according to exit polls. Despite the damaging outcome, Merz vowed to remain in his position.

Geo-Political.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
Geo-Political.summary: Vladimir Putin won Russia's presidential election as expected. The Kremlin will likely use this victory to claim widespread public support for the war in Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: US and China discuss AI safety plan ahead of Trump-Xi summit
Geo-Political.summary: Top US and Chinese officials met in New York on Sunday to discuss an artificial intelligence safety plan. The talks took place ahead of a scheduled summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping this week.

Geo-Political.title: Jailed teacher convicted of sexual abuse secretly released early in Indonesia, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: An Indonesian teacher convicted of sexual abuse has been secretly released after serving less than half of his prison sentence. The early release was uncovered by undercover BBC footage.

Geo-Political.title: Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband explains why he forgave her over children's killings
Geo-Political.summary: In an interview with CBS News, the husband of Lindsay Clancy explained why he forgave her for strangling their three young children. He discussed his profound grief and the complex emotions surrounding the tragic killings.

Geo-Political.title: Presley Gerber, Cindy Crawford's son, dies aged 27
Geo-Political.summary: Presley Gerber, the 27-year-old son of model Cindy Crawford, has died. His family has requested privacy during this difficult time.

Data & Insights.title: Mint explainer: why has India’s Income Tax Department stepped up its international outreach?
Data & Insights.summary: India's Income Tax Department is using overseas units to explain new tax laws to foreign entities. These units provide clarity on cross-border taxation, transfer pricing, tax treaties, and investment rules.

Data & Insights.title: Govt plans  ₹10,000-crore push to modernise India’s weather forecasting
Data & Insights.summary: India's finance ministry is reviewing a ₹10,000-crore proposal by the ministry of earth sciences. The initiative aims to modernize weather forecasting and establish a robust early-warning system.

Data & Insights.title: China drives India’s BRICS export surge to $19.9 billion; shipments to Japan, Italy, S Korea also gain
Data & Insights.summary: India's exports to BRICS nations surged 34% from April to August 2026, led by a 39% increase in shipments to China. During the same period, exports to Japan grew 43%, driven largely by energy products and electronics.

Data & Insights.title: Why does India need to save more?
Data & Insights.summary: India needs a higher savings rate to fund continuous investments in infrastructure, manufacturing, and technology. These investments are necessary to sustain an economic growth rate of 7 to 8 percent.

Data & Insights.title: Saudi Arabia exits mBridge: Can China-led platform still challenge US dollar, become global cross-border payment system?
Data & Insights.summary: Saudi Arabia quietly withdrew from the China-led mBridge digital currency project in 2025 as originally planned. Despite this exit, the platform continues to expand in its efforts to enable faster cross-border payments and reduce reliance on the US dollar and SWIFT.

Data & Insights.title: Food prices stable as pulses, cereals output rises; sugar rates ease
Data & Insights.summary: Pulses production reached a record 27.4 million tonnes in 2025-26, while cereals output increased by about 5% to 349.1 million tonnes. This rise in crop production helped stabilize food prices and ease sugar rates.

India.title: US School Charges $40,000 A Semester For Farmwork, Chores, And Limited Screen Time
India.summary: The Mountain School charges high school students $40,000 per semester for a program focused on farmwork, chores, and restricted screen time. Participants in the 10th, 12th, and 11th grades spend the term living and working together on the school's farm.

India.title: 'Wait For October 2': AIMIM's Search For Bigger Role In UP Enters New Phase
India.summary: AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi has warned political parties not to misinterpret his restrained messaging regarding alliances for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections as weakness. The party is preparing to enter a new phase in its search for a larger political role in the state by October 2.

India.title: "Dead Economy": Annamalai Mocks Vijay's London Trip, Says India Is Bigger
India.summary: Former BJP leader Annamalai criticized actor-politician Vijay for traveling to the UK instead of touring Tamil Nadu. He advised Vijay to meet local industrialists within the state rather than calling the economy dead.

India.title: Couple Allegedly Harassed In Bihar's Jamui, Disturbing Video Surfaces
India.summary: A couple was allegedly harassed by a group of attackers in Jamui, Bihar. A disturbing video of the incident surfaced showing the victims being chased as they tried to escape on their two-wheeler.

India.title: IIT Bombay Meets Protesters Over 18 Demands As Campus Suicide Row Escalates
India.summary: IIT Bombay officials and student protesters met to discuss 18 demands following an escalating campus suicide controversy. Both sides hold opposing views regarding who is responsible for the student's death.

India.title: Mental Health Reforms, No Action Against Protesters: Inside IIT Bombay Students' 18-Point Charter
India.summary: IIT Bombay students have released an 18-point charter demanding mental health reforms and no action against protesters. The demands include a committee to establish clear complaint mechanisms and rules against professors.

General.title: Young people aren't snowflakes - mental distress is rising, says head of official review
General.summary: Professor Peter Fonagy states that being young is much harder today than in the past. He attributes the dismissal of youth as snowflakes to a rising rate of mental distress.

General.title: Specialist courts for rape cases to be rolled out across England and Wales
General.summary: The UK government is funding specialist courts for rape cases across England and Wales. This funding will allow victims to view proceedings remotely and give evidence via video link from a separate room.

General.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
General.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz described his party's performance in recent state elections as a disaster after exit polls revealed damaging losses in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Despite these defeats for his centre-right CDU party, Merz vowed to remain in his position.

General.title: Oxford grooming gang survivors tell BBC 'hundreds' of abusers still free

General.title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns
General.summary: The National Association of Head Teachers in England is calling for a halt to graded Ofsted inspections. The union argues that the current inspection process poses a serious risk to the health and lives of school leaders.
